extension.summary: AB Tools - all-in-one Kodi maintenance and skin toolkit
extension.description: ABUKARIM TOOLS is an all-in-one utility for managing your Kodi setup. It bundles a Skin Installer and Skin Switcher, full backup and restore of your userdata, and quick access to the ABUKARIM Wizard and its maintenance tools (Total Clean and old thumbnail cleanup). A built-in patcher keeps popular add-ons (Seren, Prism, TinyPPI, Arctic Fuse 3, TMDbHelper, RedLight and more) working correctly on CoreELEC and Kodi, and re-applies its fixes automatically after those add-ons update. Also includes handy maintenance tools such as a speed test, a CPU benchmark and an add-on database rebuild.
extension.summary: أدوات أبوكريم - حزمة متكاملة لصيانة كودي وإدارة الواجهات
extension.description: أدوات أبوكريم هي أداة شاملة لإدارة نظام كودي لديك. تجمع بين مثبّت الواجهات ومبدّل الواجهات، والنسخ الاحتياطي الكامل لبيانات المستخدم واستعادتها، ووصولاً سريعاً إلى معالج أبوكريم وأدوات الصيانة فيه (التنظيف الشامل وحذف الصور المصغّرة القديمة). كما تتضمّن أداة ترقيع مدمجة تُبقي الإضافات الشائعة (Seren وTinyPPI وArctic Fuse 3 وTMDbHelper وRedLight وغيرها) تعمل بشكل صحيح على CoreELEC وكودي، وتعيد تطبيق إصلاحاتها تلقائياً بعد تحديث تلك الإضافات. وتشمل أيضاً أدوات صيانة مفيدة مثل اختبار السرعة واختبار أداء المعالج وإعادة بناء قاعدة بيانات الإضافات.
extension.news: v4.6.24 - AF3 Plot on the Right: the quality badges (SD / SDR / AAC / 1.0) move to the bottom of the info column - title, genre, date line, ratings, badges. v4.6.23 - AF3 Plot on the Right: the genre sits right under the title, and the info lines have a little more space between them. v4.6.22 - AF3 Lucent Look: one icon set on the player bar - new Lucent line icons for Subtitle Cycler, Subtitle Sync, Subtitle Look and PPI, and the focused Info / Audio / Subtitles / Video buttons keep their Lucent icon (dark on the white circle) instead of switching to AF3's. v4.6.21 - AF3 Plot on the Right: no empty band under the info column (it moves down to sit above the row title), the plot box stays inside the page margin and is centred on the column, and a running time of 0 no longer shows "0 minutes". v4.6.19 - AF3: tidier Home info - the plot box is centred on the info column and hugs the text with even padding, the genre line sits on the same spacing as the info rows, no stray dot before the stars, and "2 hours 0 minutes" reads "2 hours". v4.6.18 - AF3: Plot on the Right - the glass box now fits the plot (short plot = small box), it is lighter and more transparent, and switching it on also turns on the skin's Two-line information bar (turned back off with the switch if AB Tools turned it on). v4.6.17 - the box sits under the info line. Older versions: see changelog.txt.
